description: A live economy as it is on chain: the project, every pool’s balance, every record the spec names (found or missing). Reads the economy’s own cluster: devnet through its public RPC (or XSOLANA_RPC_URL), mainnet through XSOLANA_RPC_URL, which must then name a mainnet RPC.

spec.description: An economy spec (version 2) given inline. Takes precedence over file and example.

name: xsolana_status
